name: power-pages
description: Create and deploy Power Pages sites using modern development approaches. Supports code sites (SPAs) with React, Angular, Vue, or Astro. Adds multilingual localization and safe runtime LTR/RTL switching for React, Vue, and Angular runtime sites; Astro and Angular static localization are temporarily unavailable. Includes ALM orchestration (plan-alm) with a solution-splitting decision tree, per-solution pipelines, Azure Blob asset advisory, manifest schema v2 for multi-solution deployments, and force-link remediation for cross-host pipeline migrations.
